title: Imaging of Small Cell Lung Cancer: An Updated Overview of Current and Emerging Applications.
authors: Cha, Min Jae; Choi, Hyewon; Nam, Boda; Oh, Chung Ryul; Lee, Se-Hoon; Choi, Joon Young; Chong, Semin; Han, Joungho; Lee, Kyung Soo
one_liner_zh: 该文综述小细胞肺癌的影像学应用，虽提及转录因子亚型但无蛋白质-DNA互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Small cell lung cancer (SCLC) is an aggressive pulmonary neuroendocrine carcinoma characterized by rapid progression and early metastasis. Despite recent therapeutic advances, including immune checkpoint inhibitors and emerging targeted agents, survival outcomes remain poor. Recent molecular insights have identified four transcription factor-driven subtypes-SCLC-A, SCLC-N, SCLC-P, and the inflamed subtype SCLC-I-providing a framework for precision and immunotherapy-based strategies. This review summarizes the evolving scope of imaging in SCLC and highlights emerging approaches that support personalized medicine. Conventional imaging with CT, MRI, and fluorine 18 fluorodeoxyglucose PET/CT remains essential for diagnosis, staging, and treatment response assessment. Semiquantitative, volume-based PET/CT metrics, such as metabolic tumor volume and total lesion glycolysis, correlate with tumor proliferation and provide stronger prognostic value than maximum standardized uptake value. Emerging imaging approaches, including radiomics, radiogenomics, and machine learning, may further enable noninvasive tumor characterization and outcome prediction. Recent advances in molecular imaging, including delta-like ligand 3- and somatostatin receptor-targeted immune-PET, represent key steps toward biomarker-guided and personalized therapy. Together, integration of structural, functional, and molecular imaging with biologic insights is expected to shape the next phase of precision oncology in this highly aggressive malignancy. Keywords: Lung, Imaging Modality, PET, MRI, Molecular Imaging, Oncology, Neoplasms-Primary, CT, MR Imaging, Diagnosis, PET/CT, Small Cell Lung Cancer, Radiogenomics, Machine Learning, Radiolabeled Tracer, Personalized Medicine Supplemental material is available for this article. abstract_zh: 小细胞肺癌（SCLC）是一种侵袭性肺神经内分泌癌，以快速进展和早期转移为特征。尽管近期治疗取得进展，包括免疫检查点抑制剂和新兴靶向药物，生存结局仍不理想。最近的分子学见解已识别出四种转录因子驱动的亚型——SCLC-A、SCLC-N、SCLC-P 及炎症亚型 SCLC-I——为精准和基于免疫治疗的策略提供了框架。本综述总结了 SCLC 影像学的不断演变范围，并强调了支持个体化医疗的新兴方法。常规影像学，包括 CT、MRI 和氟 18 氟脱氧葡萄糖 PET/CT，在诊断、分期和治疗反应评估中仍至关重要。半定量、基于体积的 PET/CT 指标，如代谢肿瘤体积和总病灶糖酵解，与肿瘤增殖相关，并提供比最大标准化摄取值更强的预后价值。新兴影像学方法，包括影像组学 (radiomics)、影像基因组学 (radiogenomics) 和机器学习，可能进一步实现非侵入性肿瘤表征和结局预测。分子影像学的最新进展，包括 delta-like ligand 3 和生长抑素受体靶向免疫 PET，代表了向生物标志物引导和个体化治疗迈进的关键步骤。总之，将结构、功能和分子影像学与生物学见解相结合，预计将塑造这种高度侵袭性恶性肿瘤精准肿瘤学的下一阶段。关键词：肺，影像学模态，PET，MRI，分子影像学，肿瘤学，原发性肿瘤，CT，MR 成像，诊断，PET/CT，小细胞肺癌，影像基因组学，机器学习，放射性标记示踪剂，个体化医疗 本文提供补充材料。(c) RSNA, 2026.
